rules.title: Typed signatures
rules.body: New and changed functions and methods declare parameter, return and property types.

rules.title: Bound parameters for SQL
rules.body: Queries take values as bound parameters (PDO prepared statements or the query builder); never interpolate values into SQL strings.

rules.title: Validate before use
rules.body: Request data is validated (Form Requests or validate()) and only the validated data is used; never pass $request->all() into create or update.

rules.title: Escape output
rules.body: Values shown in HTML go through the template engine's escaping; raw output ({!! !!}, echo of request data) only for trusted, sanitised strings.

rules.title: No error suppression
rules.body: Do not use the @ operator to suppress errors, and do not leave catch blocks empty.
